- [u-L0017-04] She tells Caelynn that all she could hear was mumbling about the forest leaving and that something strange happened to the time.
- [u-L0017-03] Caelynn relays her request and Sara calls Lysandra.
- [u-L0017-05] Sara then connects Caelynn directly to Lysandra who is relieved and overjoyed that the group is ok and that they took care of the forest.
- [u-L0017-07] Lysandra tells her that she can't remember much after the group left, only that she decided to go around the forest and she could smell meat while trying to sleep.
- [u-L0021-07] Caelynn calls Sara to tell her the good news about Lysandra, and bad news about the tainted meat.
- [u-L0017-06] Caelynn wants to know if she is ok and where she is.
- [u-L0019-07] The first thing Caelynn notices about Lysandra is that her eyes are shimmery, just like the members of the cult.
- [u-L0005-08] After conferring with Lysandra, they determine that they are 3 days from Mirathorn and the next little town north along the road will be Mireward, about 5 days out.
- [u-L0011-09] In need of a friend, she approaches Lysandra to tell her what just happened, but Lysandra doesn't appear to notice that Caelynn is barely holding back tears.
- [u-L0011-12] She takes the chance to approach Caelynn again and asks for some tea and finally notices the state that Caelynn is in.
- [u-L0011-14] After collecting herself, she tells Caelynn that she has done a little investigation into the person they spoke about back in the city and how she finally sees how much the group does for her.
- [u-L0013-01] Ephanna moves in to speak with Lysandra and tell her about the earlier call to Mirathorn.
- [u-L0015-07] And now that the danger has passed Caelynn asks the mayor about Lysandra, but finds out that they have never heard of her.
- [u-L0017-08] She is exhausted and disoriented.
- [u-L0017-01] Caelynn quickly pulls out the "rockie-talkie" and attempts to call Lysandra.
- [u-L0017-09] Caelynn tells her to stop where she is and make a camp and rest, Karesmine will lead the team to her.
- [u-L0019-04] Caelynn approaches the makeshift shelter and hears mumbling from inside.
- [u-L0019-05] She finds Lysandra drawing in the dirt.
- [u-L0019-11] Finally, after drinking the tea, Lysandra comes out of the spell.
- [u-L0005-07] From this position they can see out along the plains for a fairly long distance.
- [u-L0011-08] And things don't appear to be improving.
- [u-L0013-02] Lysandra decides to make a call herself, but does not even get an answer.
- [u-L0019-12] She is very confused, wondering where she is and how she got there.
- [u-L0019-13] All that she is able to remember is voices in the dark after the group left into the forest.
- [u-L0005-06] They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove of trees.
- [u-L0019-08] She quickly begins to make the antidote from the tea in her bag.

- [u-L0003-06] Stafl and Lysandra, both in need of a good rest, lay down in the back of the wagon, using this time to recharge while they travel.
- [u-L0011-11] Lysandra then notices Ephanna talking with her while she is brewing some tea.
- [u-L0011-13] Now it's Lysandra's turn to burst into tears.
- [u-L0019-01] Using her extensive tracking skills, Karesmine is able to estimate the distance and direction that Lysandra may have traveled.
- [u-L0003-01] While still waiting for a response Caelynn studies the sky once again.
- [u-L0019-06] She says it is a tower where the voices are coming from and she knows where it is.

- [u-L0011-02] Ephanna takes the next watch, and the only notable thing that happens is they find a strangely flat rock, which they put into their pack.
- [u-L0003-03] The group then decides to load up the wagon and head out in hopes of beating the storm.
- [u-L0003-14] They warn the sheriff about tainted meat and Karsemine uses her Thaumaturgy to show them what to look for when people begin to change.
- [u-L0011-03] Shortly after sunrise Caelynn decides to call Mirathorn again.
- [u-L0011-05] He apologizes to her, telling Caelynn that the city resumed the Festival and it was a long night.
- [u-L0013-08] Using her bracelet she is able to diffuse the aggression and get everyone back to work, united against the approaching forest.
- [u-L0015-06] Marla approaches Caelynn and asks her how she should deal with Bonogo, but Ephanna quickly intervenes, letting her, and the town, know that the Questionable Company is leaving town to continue their journey.
- [u-L0023-01] Caelynn continues to wait on the line for an answer from Tealeaf as the rest of the group set up a proper camp for a rest.
- [u-L0005-01] They continue on north with Karsemine and Caelynn keeping an eye out for high ground for a place to stop for the night.
- [u-L0013-07] Marla then grapples Bonogo and is about to do much worse when Caelynn comes to the rescue.
- [u-L0015-01] Questionable Company, along with the townsfolk, watch as the forest comes within range of their plan.
- [u-L0015-02] As the forest finally reaches the fortifications, the fires are lit in the ditches.
